1.q: What is the maximum PM Surya Ghar subsidy?
1.a: For eligible residential rooftop systems of 3 kW and above, the highlighted subsidy is up to ₹78,000 (1 kW ₹30,000; 2 kW ₹60,000). Final amount depends on government policy and approval.

2.a: Typically Aadhaar, PAN, latest electricity bill, and bank account details. We help you prepare the full file.

3.a: Nationalised bank solar loans are promoted at around 6% annual interest in our campaigns. Actual rates and eligibility depend on the bank.

4.a: Panel warranties are commonly up to 25 years; inverter warranties are often up to 2 years, depending on brand and terms.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.body: AMMA SOLAR collects only the information you share via contact forms or WhatsApp (such as name, phone, city, and electricity bill details) to respond to your inquiry and arrange surveys. We do not sell your data. Messages may be processed on WhatsApp and, when configured, email. Contact us to request deletion of inquiry data we hold.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.body: Website content is for general information about AMMA SOLAR services and government solar schemes. Subsidy figures, interest rates, and deadlines shown are based on our marketing materials and current publicly promoted scheme details; they are not a legal offer. Final quotations, warranties, and scheme benefits are confirmed in writing after survey and eligibility checks. Maharashtra jurisdiction applies.
